name: Where Is the Unseen Razor? (In Effect)
description: The first time this character is switched in: If their Character Level is lower than the opposing active character, then Character Level +1 for the Whole Match. If their HP is lower, then Max HP +6 for the Whole Match. If their ATK is lower, then ATK +1 for the Whole Match.
